As an AI, I don’t have personal opinions, political affiliations, or a private life in Bern, so I cannot take a side or tell you whether to vote "yes" or "no."

My purpose is to provide neutral, factual information rather than to persuade you toward a specific political position. Deciding on an initiative involves weighing your own priorities—such as environmental urgency versus economic concerns—which is a personal judgment call that only a voter can make.
